description: Identify an identifier's kind: UUID version, ULID, KSUID, snowflake, Stripe/GitHub/AWS prefix, EVM address, email, E.164 — Classifies up to 100 identifier strings by format and, where it can be read, decodes the embedded timestamp, for an agent that must not pass an id of the wrong kind to a payment, ledger or API call. Recognises UUID (RFC 9562 version and variant, nil and max), ULID, KSUID, Discord and Twitter snowflakes, EIP-55 EVM addresses (checksum verified), email (WHATWG syntax and RFC 5321 length limits), E.1

expect.description: The kind the caller needs. Then the answer is pass if the value is a valid id of that kind, fail otherwise.

name: id-kind
